message.content:
This editorial illustration for the magazine "TEMPO" dated "28 APRIL-4 MEI 2014" features a light blue-grey textured background. On the right, a fair-skinned man with short grey hair, wearing a black tracksuit with white stripes and white athletic shoes, is depicted in mid-stride. He is crossing a white finish line while breaking through a yellow ribbon. His arms are raised, pointing his index fingers upward, and his head is tilted back, looking up.

On the left, a large black van is partially visible. Its rear door is open, revealing a barred window. The letters "KPK" are printed in red and white on the open door's panel. The man appears to be running directly toward the open back of this vehicle.

Large white text at the top reads "TEMPO". Above it, smaller black text reads "MENGGANGSIR TANAH JAKARTA" and "PASUKAN RAHASIA PRABOWO SUBIANTO". Centered below the masthead is the headline "AKHIR PERJALANAN HADI POERNOMO" in bold black capital letters. Beneath this, smaller text reads: "Mengurangi pajak BCA, bekas Direktur Jenderal Pajak jadi tersangka. Diyakini tak berdiri sendiri." A barcode and price information are in the bottom left corner.
